title: Kotobaya sync: shared definitions
description: Scalar types shared by every op payload. See SYNC.md section 2.

uuid.description: UUID in canonical lowercase 8-4-4-4-12 form. New ids are UUIDv7 generated by whoever creates the row.

hlc.description: Hybrid logical clock, 54 chars: <12 hex wall-clock ms>-<4 hex counter>-<minting device uuid>. Byte-wise string order is clock order. SYNC.md section 3.

instant_ms.description: An instant as integer milliseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC.

entry_seq.description: JMdict sequence number (ref.dict_entry.seq). Soft reference: never validated against the dictionary.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256; a blob hash.

key.description: Lowercase identifier: a note field key, a card kind, or a deck settings key.

tags.description: The complete tag set: no duplicates, no whitespace inside a tag, case-sensitive, sorted ascending by Unicode code point by the op's author. Replicas store it as given. Never contains the virtual tag 'leech'.

item_key.description: Identity of a deck item inside its deck: 'e:<entry_seq>' (decimal, no leading zeros) or 'n:<note uuid>'.

template.description: One card kind of a note type. Unknown keys are preserved.

default.description: true = clients create this card automatically with a new note.

front.description: Front HTML with {{field_key}} placeholders; null = the core's built-in template.

back.description: Back HTML; null = the core's built-in template.
